_comment: Look and feel of BP_Ship_Wayfarer, applied by Tools/Assets/import_ship.py after the size-based values from the manifest (everything here wins). Flight numbers from Wayfarer_spec.json (SCM 225 m/s, accelerations main 70 / retro 45 / strafe 40 / up 45 / down 35 m/s2, pitch / yaw / roll 55 / 48 / 150 deg/s). First flyable version (24. 9. 2026): Higgsfield exterior, no modelled interior yet, so the placeholder cockpit is on.

pawn._comment_gear: Modelled gear (SM_Ship_Wayfarer_Gear): two collision hulls reach down to the pads (z -2.70 m), so the root box ends at the soles and gear_extension_cm is 0; stowed, the legs rise 110 cm (longest leg below the belly at -1.63).
pawn._comment_cockpit: No interior yet (step 4 builds it from the layout): the placeholder cockpit keeps the HUD from floating in empty space.

camera_boom._comment: About 0.8 x the length, as the chase camera settled for the previous ship.

materials._comment: One re-baked texture set (Tools/Blender/build_ai_ship.py) on the PBR master, plus the pod nozzle discs. The Higgsfield paint is already light (warm off-white), so no tint.
